body:
## Pull request overview

This PR updates the documentation and navigation to reflect the reclassification and renaming of `@object-ui/plugin-object` to the core package `@object-ui/views`, and promotes Views docs into top‑level navigation.

**Changes:**
- Updated all relevant documentation imports and internal links from `@object-ui/plugin-object` and `/docs/plugins/...` to `@object-ui/views` and `/docs/views/...`.
- Moved the Views docs into a new top-level `/docs/views` section with its own `meta.json`, and wired it into the main docs navigation.
- Adjusted the plugins index and metadata so that Views is clearly treated as a core package, not a plugin.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `content/docs/views/object-view.mdx` | Updated example import to `@object-ui/views` and retargeted internal links from `/docs/plugins/plugin-object/*` to `/docs/views/*`. |
| `content/docs/views/object-grid.mdx` | Updated example import to `@object-ui/views` and migration guide links from `/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-grid-migration` to `/docs/views/object-grid-migration`. |
| `content/docs/views/object-form.mdx` | Updated example import to `@object-ui/views` and all related component links to point to `/docs/views/*`. |
| `content/docs/views/object-field.mdx` | Updated “Related Components” links from `/docs/plugins/plugin-object/*` to `/docs/views/*`. |
| `content/docs/views/meta.json` | Renamed section title from “Plugin Object” to “Views” and ensured pages list uses the new views docs filenames. |
| `content/docs/views/index.mdx` | Updated overview links for ObjectGrid, ObjectForm, and ObjectView to target the new `/docs/views/*` paths. |
| `content/docs/plugins/meta.json` | Removed `views` from the plugins section so Views is no longer treated as a plugin in navigation metadata. |
| `content/docs/plugins/index.md` | Updated links and descriptions so Views is referenced as a core package at `/docs/views` and via `@object-ui/views`. |
| `content/docs/meta.json` | Added `views` as a top-level docs section alongside `guide`, `components`, and `plugins`. |
</details>
